mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT msm.FACTORY_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_DESC, msm.MOULD_CODE, msm.MAIN_PATTERN, mmi.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, mmi.MOULD_TYPE, mmi.MOULD_STATUS, mmi.SHELL_STANDARD, mmi.LOGISTICS_STATUS, '01' AS RELATION_TYPE FROM t_mdm_sku_mould_rel msm LEFT JOIN t_mdm_mould_info mmi ON mmi.FACTORY_CODE = msm.FACTORY_CODE AND mmi.MOULD_CODE = msm.MOULD_CODE AND IFNULL(mmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(msm.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND msm.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_dp_demand_plan prp WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND msm.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND msm.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE)

SELECT mdp.FACTORY_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_DESC, mdp.MOULD_CODE, mdp.BOARDING_DATE, mdp.MAIN_PATTERN, mdp.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, '' AS MOULD_TYPE, 1 AS MOULD_STATUS, '-99' AS SHELL_STANDARD, 1 AS LOGISTICS_STATUS, '02' AS RELATION_TYPE FROM t_mdm_mould_delivery_plan mdp INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_DESC FROM t_dp_demand_plan WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND `YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND `MONTH` = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS filtered_plans ON mdp.FACTORY_CODE = filtered_plans.FACTORY_CODE AND mdp.MATERIAL_DESC = filtered_plans.MATERIAL_DESC WHERE mdp.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mdp.BOARDING_DATE <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT msm.FACTORY_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_DESC, msm.MAIN_PATTERN, NULL AS BOARDING_DATE, mmi.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, mmi.MOULD_TYPE, mmi.MOULD_STATUS, mmi.SHELL_STANDARD, mmi.LOGISTICS_STATUS, '01' AS RELATION_TYPE, CASE WHEN msm.SHARE_MOULD_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(msm.SHARE_MOULD_CODE) != '' THEN msm.SHARE_MOULD_CODE ELSE msm.MOULD_CODE END AS MOULD_CODE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT mpi.MATERIAL_DESC FROM t_mp_proc_month_plan_init mpi WHERE mpi.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mpi.IS_PRODUCTION = '1' AND mpi.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mpi.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mpi.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mpi.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mpi.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS filtered_mpi INNER JOIN t_mdm_sku_mould_rel msm ON msm.MATERIAL_DESC = filtered_mpi.MATERIAL_DESC AND msm.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND msm.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN t_mdm_mould_info mmi ON mmi.FACTORY_CODE = msm.FACTORY_CODE AND mmi.MOULD_CODE = msm.MOULD_CODE AND mmi.IS_DELETE = 0

SELECT mdp.FACTORY_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_DESC, mdp.MOULD_CODE, mdp.BOARDING_DATE, mdp.MAIN_PATTERN, mdp.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, '' AS MOULD_TYPE, 1 AS MOULD_STATUS, '-99' AS SHELL_STANDARD, 1 AS LOGISTICS_STATUS, '02' AS RELATION_TYPE FROM t_mdm_mould_delivery_plan mdp INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_DESC FROM t_mp_proc_month_plan_init WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND IS_PRODUCTION = '1' AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND `YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND `MONTH` = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS filtered_plans ON mdp.FACTORY_CODE = filtered_plans.FACTORY_CODE AND mdp.MATERIAL_DESC = filtered_plans.MATERIAL_DESC WHERE mdp.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mdp.BOARDING_DATE <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}
SELECT FACTORY_CODE, MOULD_SET_CODE, MACHINE_QTY, ON_HAND_QTY, TOTAL_QTY FROM t_mdm_mould_shell_info WHERE IFNULL(IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT mma.FACTORY_CODE, mma.MAIN_PATTERN, mma.PATTERN, mma.STRUCTURE_NAME, mma.SPECIFICATIONS, mma.ALLOCATION_QTY FROM t_mdm_mould_allocation mma WHERE IFNULL(mma.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mma.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mma.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mma.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
